description: WHEN a custom parametric object is needed that no catalogue has (a made-to-measure shelf, a counter, a pergola, a technical box): try a family DEFINED AS DATA, like a Revit family — typed and bounded parameters, derived formulas, constraints, and solids whose dimensions are expressions (arithmetic, comparisons, min/max/round, a if c else b; nothing else is evaluated). Returns the computed values, constraint findings and solids in mm. To place it, add the definition under `familles` and instances under `instances` in any CAO scene: they become boxes in plans, 3D and quantities, and typed IFC objects with their parameters.

famille.description: The family definition: libelle, categorie (mobilier, equipement, structure, menuiserie, divers), parametres {name: {defaut, min, max, entier, choix}}, formules {name: expression}, contraintes [{si, message}], solides [{nom, x, y, z, l, p, h, repeter, si}].
